mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.kb_version_id, c.doc_revision_id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.dimensions, c.acl_mode, c.external_id, c.document_title, c.source_version, c.created_at_ms, c.updated_at_ms FROM cw_knowledge_chunk c JOIN cw_knowledge_version v ON v.kb_version_id = c.kb_version_id AND v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.access_status = 'READY' AND c.acl_mode = 'PUBLIC' AND c.id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT c.doc_revision_id FROM cw_knowledge_chunk c JOIN cw_knowledge_version v ON v.kb_version_id = c.kb_version_id AND v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.kb_version_id = #{kbVersionId} AND v.access_status = 'READY' AND c.acl_mode = 'PUBLIC'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_knowledge_chunk (kb_version_id, doc_revision_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, dimensions, acl_mode, external_id, document_title, source_version, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{chunk.kbVersionId}, #{chunk.docRevisionId}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.embedding}, #{chunk.dimensions}, #{chunk.aclMode}, #{chunk.externalId}, #{chunk.documentTitle}, #{chunk.sourceVersion}, #{chunk.createdAtMs}, #{chunk.updatedAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), content = VALUES(content), embedding = VALUES(embedding), dimensions = VALUES(dimensions), acl_mode = VALUES(acl_mode), external_id = VALUES(external_id), document_title = VALUES(document_title), source_version = VALUES(source_version), updated_at_ms = VALUES(updated_at_ms)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_title AS title, v.kb_name AS knowledge_base, v.version_no, c.source_version, c.contentNULL AS content FROM cw_knowledge_chunk c JOIN cw_knowledge_version v ON v.kb_version_id = c.kb_version_id AND v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.kb_code = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND c.kb_version_id = #{versionId} AND c.doc_revision_id = #{revisionId} AND c.id = #{chunkId} AND v.access_status = 'READY' AND c.acl_mode = 'PUBLIC'
